attributes.description: SRE dashboard for OVH AI/ML deployments and training jobs. Tracks deployment health, replica availability, resource allocation (CPU/GPU/memory), training job success rates, job duration, error rates, and per-user/per-instance activity.

embeddableConfig.content:
## OVH AI/ML — Deploy & Training Operations
🖥️ **Deployments** (`ovh_ai_ml.deploy`) · ⚙️ **Training Jobs** (`ovh_ai_ml.training`) · Region: `gra` · Provider: `ovh`

> SRE view: deployment availability, replica health, resource saturation, training job success rate, failure detection, and job queue depth.
